messages:
maria_sales: Quick sync — ACME trial POC. They want a 2-week sandbox for an assist/search/rerank flow. Main asks: sample dataset (size + schema), redaction rules, storage/connectivity, and concrete success criteria. Can we align scope and deliverables?

devon_se: Sounds good. Do they need embeddings + rerank or just generation? Also: expected QPS and latency targets? Those drive sizing.

maria_sales: ACME says embeddings + rerank + a small generative assistant for follow-ups. PM mentioned peak ~8 QPS, median latency goal ~200ms for gen.

alex_eng: For sandbox we can do presigned S3 + IAM-limited access for quick turn. If they need network isolation it's a Private deployment (longer lead time). Recommend presigned for initial trial.

sarah_cs: From the customer's success doc: 1) retrieval precision >= 0.7 on our prompt set, 2) median generation latency <200ms under 8 QPS, 3) zero PII leaks in outputs for the eval prompts. I'll add their eval prompts to the folder.

maria_sales: Perfect. Legal flagged a security questionnaire and DPA requirement — do we need a separate approval for sample data types (PII)?

legal-bot: Legal note: please provide dataflow diagram + redaction rules before we sign DPA. If sample contains real PII we need explicit sign-off and retention policy.

devon_se: For the evals: propose ~20 retrieval prompts and ~15 generative prompts, plus a small PII membership test set. For infra sizing: for short trial we can run on hosted GPUs but recommend equivalent of g4dn.12xlarge for Dedicated to meet latency.

alex_eng: Redaction pipeline suggestion (we can provide script/snippet):

```
python redact.py --input sample.csv --fields email,ssn,phone --mode mask --out sanitized.csv
```

We can also provide a 5k-row sanitized sample for initial ingest and an ingest notebook for embeddings. If they insist on real production data, require checklist + DPA + ops review.

infra-bot: Provisioning ticket created: INF-4821. Scope: temporary S3 bucket + presigned upload, IAM role limited to bucket, short-lived creds. ETA: 2 business days.

devon_se: Pricing note: for a 2-week Dedicated pilot we usually route to finance for short-term pilot rates. We can offer pilot credits and a discounted short commit — will confirm numbers offline.

sarah_cs: I'll own the evaluation run once sample is uploaded. I'll script automated checks: precision/recall, latency histogram, and PII detection checks on outputs.

maria_sales: Action items: 
- maria_sales: request sample schema from ACME and attach their security questionnaire.
- alex_eng: prepare sanitized sample + redact script + ingest notebook.
- devon_se: produce sizing recommendation + pilot cost estimate.
- infra-bot: follow INF-4821 and provision presigned S3 + IAM.
- legal-bot: track DPA and validate redaction rules.

alex_eng: I'll send the sanitized sample + notebook to ACME contact later today and include presigned upload instructions.

devon_se: Also flag: if ACME plans to use >2k token contexts we'll suggest quantized model variant; call it out in the handoff doc.

maria_sales: Thanks — will update the account exec and ACME PM. Ping here if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
